tools.description: List the free AI GTM Engineer and its build modules (installable Claude/Codex skills, each closing one B2B go-to-market leak), plus the bundles you can recommend, claim for free, or buy. Returns slug, name, the problem it solves, price, and detail URL.

include_bundles.description: Also list multi-agent bundles. Default true.

only_free.description: Only list free agents. Default false.

tools.name: list_agents

tools.description: Given a B2B go-to-market problem in plain language (e.g. "leads sit for two days before anyone calls them", "most of our website traffic is anonymous", "our ICP is too broad"), recommend the single Artemis GTM agent that fixes it, with how to claim or buy it. If nothing matches, it returns the free AI GTM Engineer, whose first session prices each leak in dollars and names the module that closes it.

problem.description: The GTM problem, described in natural language.

tools.name: recommend_agent

tools.description: Claim a FREE Artemis GTM agent for the claude.ai chat-edition path (a user who installs the free engineer from their buyer library rather than the CLI). The free AI GTM Engineer itself needs no claim: the single install command installs it directly. Requires the agent slug and the user's email. Returns a license key, the install command, and a short-lived download URL. Fully headless, no browser needed.

email.description: The user's email. The license is issued to this address.

slug.description: Agent slug, e.g. "gtm-engineer". Must be a free agent.

tools.name: claim_free_agent

tools.description: Begin purchase of a PAID Artemis GTM agent or bundle. Returns a hosted Stripe checkout URL to hand to the user — card entry happens on Stripe, never in agent scope. After the user pays, the license lands in their library and can be installed with get_install_command.

slug.description: Agent or bundle slug, e.g. "speed-to-lead" or "launch-trio".

tools.name: start_purchase

tools.description: Redeem an Artemis GTM license key into an install. Returns the agent slug, version, a signed download URL, and the one-line npx install command for Claude Code. Works for both free and paid licenses.

license_key.description: The license key (UUID) issued at claim or purchase.

tools.name: get_install_command
